keyEvents.text: Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Miro Muheim (Hamburger SV).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Kofi Amoako replaces Miro Muheim because of an injury.
Warmed Omari (Hamburger SV) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Chuki (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Werder Bremen 0, Hamburger SV 0.
Delay in match (Werder Bremen).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Werder Bremen 1, Hamburger SV 0. Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the high centre of the goal following a corner.
Goal! Werder Bremen 2, Hamburger SV 0. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Niclas Füllkrug.
Goal! Werder Bremen 3, Hamburger SV 0. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Ludovit Reis.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Otto Stange replaces Alexander Røssing-Lelesiit.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Fábio Vieira replaces Kofi Amoako.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Terem Moffi replaces Patson Daka.
Nicolás Capaldo (Hamburger SV) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Werder Bremen. Paul Erevbenagie replaces Eren Dinkçi.
Substitution, Werder Bremen. Dariusz Stalmach replaces Chuki.
Albert Grønbæk (Hamburger SV) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
